sentences.text:
Appellant had filed I.A. No.26366/2025, which is eighth application under Section 430(1) of BNSS,
2023 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail.

2. Appellant-Ansar @ Bachcha has been convicted for commission of offence under Sections 366,
376-D of IPC and sentenced to undergo R.I. for five years with fine of Rs.5,000/- and R.I. for twenty years with fine of Rs.5,000/- respectively, with default stipulation.
3. Counsel appearing for appellant submitted that jail sentence of co-appellant namely Mehboob Ali has been suspended by this Court vide order dated 18.02.2019 passed in CRA No.7545/2018.
As per Exhibit- P/15, DNA of Mehboob matched with the source collected from prosecutrix.
Case of present appellant is much better than case of co- accused person namely Mehboob.
It is submitted that DNA of present appellant did not match with the material collected from prosecutrix at source.
It is also submitted that appellant was not known to the 2 CRA-9353-2018 prosecutrix and his identity could not also be established.
There was no proper cross-examination of the appellant in this case.
It is further submitted that appellant has already suffered the jail sentence of more than ten years.
Appellant does not have any other criminal antecedent or record.
Hearing of appeal might take some time.
Under these circumstances, it is prayed that custodial sentence of appellant ought to have been suspended and he ought to have been released on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the application for suspension of sentence.
It is submitted that jail sentence is of twenty years.
Offence committed by appellant is heinous in nature.
Gang rape has been committed upon the prosecutrix.

It is also submitted that Ansar @ Bachcha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191245211/
1 accused has been identified by the victim.

sentences.text: In these circumstances, appellant may not be released on bail and bail application of appellant may be dismissed.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties and pursued the record.
6.
On going through evidence available on record, it is found that DNA of appellant does not match with the material which has been collected at source from prosecutrix.
Exhibit-P/15 is negative in respect of present appellant.
DNA was positive in respect of co-appellant namely Mehboob who has been enlarged on bail vide order dated 18.02.2019 passed in CRA No.7545/2018.
Case of appellant is much better than the case of other co-accused persons.
Appellant does not have any criminal antecedent or record.
He is in jail since last more than ten years.
3 CRA-9353-2018 7. Considering totality of facts and circumstances of the case, application (I.A. No.26366/2025) for suspension of sentence is allowed.

It is hereby directed that the custodial sentence awarded to the appellant shall remain suspended during the pendency of this appeal and he shall be released on bail on his furnishing bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 15.06.2026 and on other dates as may be fixed in this regard till final disposal of this appeal.
8. Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) (B. P. SH  JUDGE JUDG  @shish Ansar @ Bachcha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 2 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191245211/
